test_case.question: What is S. R. Group of Institutions (SRGI) Lucknow and where is it located?

results.answer: S. R. Group of Institutions (SRGI) Lucknow is a premier multi-disciplinary technical and professional education group established in 2009. The institution operates under the aegis of the Subedar Raj Devi Educational Trust, which was founded in 2008 under the Societies Registration Act, 1860. SRGI Lucknow is located on NH-24, Sitapur Road, Bakshi ka Talab (BKT), Lucknow - 226201, Uttar Pradesh. The campus is situated on NH-24, Sitapur Road, Bakshi ka Talab (BKT), Lucknow - 226201, Uttar Pradesh.

results.answer: The SRGI Lucknow consists of several faculties and constituent institutes as part of its academic ecosystem. Here is the breakdown: ### Academic Faculties: 1. Faculty of Engineering & Technology - Computer Science & Engineering - Information Technology - Electronics & Communication Engineering - Electrical & Electronics Engineering - Mechanical Engineering - Civil Engineering - Biotechnology - Agricultural Engineering 2. Faculty of Management Studies - Business Administration (MBA) - Integrated MBA (IMBA) - Applied Global Management Programme (AGMP) 3. Faculty of Skill & Vocational Studies - Software Development (SD) - Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI) - Automobile Engineering (AE) 4. Faculty of Medical & Allied Health Sciences - SRM Ayush Institute of Medical Sciences - Department of Pharmacy (D.Pharm) - Nursing & Paramedical Sciences - Department of Homeopathy (DHP) ### Constituent Institutes: 1. S. R. Institute of Management & Technology (SRIMT) - Offers Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech), Master of Technology (M.Tech), and Management (MBA, IMBA, AGMP) programmes. - Affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow. 2. SRM Business School (SRMBS) - Housed under SRIMT, offers MBA and Integrated MBA (IMBA) programmes. - Affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow.

There is also a 400-meter running track for athletic events and a Hostel Sports League. Your parents can also take advantage of the residential services, which include a central library with 53,760+ books and 448+ journals, and a central library system. The campus is situated along the major educational highway corridor of National Highway 24 (NH-24), connecting Lucknow and Sitapur. It is located in the educational hub of Bakshi ka Talab (BKT), Lucknow - 226201. The campus environment is designed with state-of-the-art academic complexes, futuristic laboratories, residential blocks, auditoriums, and sports facilities. Urban transit is seamless, with college-operated transit fleets serving students and staff across Lucknow city and adjoining regions.
